name: Villa Le Blanc Gran Melia
positioning: Gran Melia beach hotel right on Santo Tomas beach in Menorca, a Leading Hotels of the World member with interiors inspired by the island's vernacular architecture
best_for: Travelers who want direct beach access from the hotel garden in Menorca
Travelers who want to explore Menorca's coves by traditional llaut boat
Couples who want a Thai spa and Menorcan seafood such as caldereta

facts.text: Villa Le Blanc Gran Melia is located right on the beach of Santo Tomas in Menorca.
The hotel has direct access to Santo Tomas beach from its garden.
The hotel's interior design is inspired by Menorca's vernacular architecture, with light flooding the spaces through large arches.
The hotel was conceived as a prototype hotel in terms of efficiency and environmental responsibility.
The hotel is a member of The Leading Hotels of the World.
At the Thai Room Spa, native Thai therapists offer massages and treatments from Thailand.
All Thai Room treatments include full access to the spa, whose circuit has a dynamic pool, outdoor hot tub, steam room and sauna.
La Terraza del Balear focuses on fresh fish, handmade rice dishes and local specialities.
Nivi is a Mediterranean grill restaurant where grilled dishes meet locally sourced Menorcan ingredients with a hint of Italian flavours.
Nivi also serves a buffet breakfast with a la carte and show cooking options.
The Sunset Master Suite has a private seafront pool.
The hotel is pet friendly, allowing up to two pets per room.

highlights.text: Guests can book the hotel's llauts, Marco Polo I and Marco Polo II, for a half or full day of sailing.
The Artist's Inspiration experience sails by llaut from Mahon port to Isla del Rey for a guided visit to the Hauser and Wirth gallery.
La Terraza del Balear serves caldereta, the traditional Menorcan lobster stew.
The Grand Blanc massage was created by Thai Room exclusively for Villa Le Blanc and includes a scrub with white sesame and Menorcan fleur de sel.
The hotel sits within the Cami de Cavalls route.

considerations.text: The hotel is 28 km from the airport and 27 km from Mahon.
At the kids club, children under 5 must be accompanied by an adult.
La Terraza del Balear has a formal dress code.
